metadata.title: A steamed sweet dish of Himachal Pradesh | घी शक्कर के साथ असक्लियां खाएं
metadata.description: Himachal Pradesh is not known for it's scenic beauty and serene atmosphere only  but for it's rich culture and food also. We travelled in the trans giri area of Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh. Giri river is one of the many tributary of the river Yamuna. Here we met people of Hattee tribe and tasted the food cooked by a family.
